confidence_notes: Food anchors use current Tirana price-index averages as a proxy for July 2026. Cocktail and wine estimates are less certain and are set at roughly 2.2 and 1.4 times the local draft-beer price. Accommodation estimates are holistic and seasonal, based on the supplied context.
comparable_city_reasoning: Tirana’s July lodging is likely below coastal Saranda and the Italian and Spanish comparables overall. Capital-city demand may keep three-star rooms near the lower end of Saranda and Cagliari; basic guesthouses and hostel beds should be cheaper.
